==About==

A {{i|Grub}} can be found most commonly by {{i|Lift}}ing any {{i|Boulder}} that has sat long enough on the surface and looking underneath. Additionally a Grub can be found by chance inside {{i|Hollow Log}}s, {{i|Hollow Stump}}s, when Dissecting {{i|Argopelter Gizzard}}s and {{i|Toad}}s, or when {{i|Dig}}ging. If placed in a [[Container]] for a few days a Grub will grow into a {{i|Beetle}}. A Grub can be used as a one use {{i|Any Bait}} when {{i|Fish}}ing.
